staffRequests.requestChangesBody: The vendor sees your note, changes the request and sends it again.
staffRequests.rejectBody: This is final. The vendor sees your note and may make a new request.

attention.waitingAcceptance: Coupons waiting for you to accept

codes.COUPON_CODE_TAKEN: Another coupon already uses this code.
codes.COUPON_INVALID: These terms do not fit together. Check them and try again.
codes.COUPON_LIMIT_BELOW_USAGE: This limit is lower than the uses already made.
codes.COUPON_LOCKED: This term can no longer change, because the coupon has been used or the vendor has agreed to it.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_INVALID: These terms break one of the rules for a coupon request. Check the dates, the limits and the discount.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_LIMIT: You already have 10 open requests. Send, withdraw or wait for one before making another.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This coupon request was not found.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_PRODUCT_INVALID: One of the chosen products is not yours.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_SELF_REVIEW: You made this request, so someone else must decide it.
codes.COUPON_REQUEST_STATE_INVALID: This cannot be done in the request's current status. Reload the page.
codes.COUPON_STATE_INVALID: This coupon is not waiting for your acceptance any more. Reload the page.
codes.COUPON_TERMS_CHANGED: The terms changed since you read them. Read them again before accepting.
codes.IMPORT_EXPIRED: This check has expired. Upload the file again.
codes.IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: This file cannot be used. Check that it is a comma-separated UTF-8 file with the right columns.
codes.IMPORT_STATE_INVALID: This import cannot be confirmed: it is already confirmed, or no product in it is ready.
